mapper.select: select s.id, s.category, s.price, s.sort_order, res.resource_code, '' as group_code, res.name, res.url as image_url, null as collect_id, s.item_desc from game_shop s join game_resource res on s.item_id = res.id where s.enabled = 1 and s.category = 1 order by s.sort_order asc, s.id asc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from game_shop s where s.enabled = 1 and s.category = 1

select count(*) from game_shop s join game_collect gc on s.item_id = gc.id where s.enabled = 1 and s.category = 2
and gc.group_code = #{groupCode}

select gc.group_code as group_code, min(s.sort_order) as min_sort from game_shop s join game_collect gc on s.item_id = gc.id where s.enabled = 1 and s.category = 2 group by gc.group_code order by min_sort asc
